headline: Nvidia has added USD 150 billion to its program for buying back its own shares.
score_reason: Pool score 7 lowered by 2: the buyback was announced on 28 Sep 2026, before the 4 Oct cutoff, and today's article mainly repeats a weekend share quote.
importance_line: Nvidia shareholders gain a larger planned buyback of the chipmaker's own shares, while the news is a week old and the source article says little beyond the announcement.
source: AD HOC NEWS, citing the NVIDIA Newsroom
summary: AD HOC NEWS reports, citing the NVIDIA Newsroom, that Nvidia's board approved another USD 150 billion for its share repurchase program (the company buying back its own shares) on 28 Sep 2026. That brings the total still available under the program to USD 235 billion.
notes: Older news: the authorization was announced 28 Sep 2026; the 4 Oct article is mostly a weekend share-price note (EUR 207.85 at Lang & Schwarz, unchanged). Company announcement relayed by AD HOC NEWS; the NVIDIA Newsroom page itself was not opened.
